body: **Foco:** Inverted hypothetical (Were I…) — prática e contraste.
**Pronúncia:** Ênfase intencional.
**22 palavras novas** (pesquisa).
**Texto do dia:** poema, haiku ou letra.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo contrastar Were I / Were it not for / Had it not been for e reconhecer o tom hipotético de um poema sobre descoberta.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: If the Lab Were Quiet
lines: Were the lab quiet, I would hear the data speak.
Were I braver, I would ask what we dare not seek.
Had it not been for a mistake in the night,
we would never have seen the unexpected light.

items.q: A mistake led to a discovery.
items.why: Had it not been for a mistake.

items.q: The speaker is certain about being brave.

frames.title: Contraste: Were I… × Had it not been for…

head: Estrutura
Tempo da hipótese
Exemplo
rows: Were it not for…, would + base
**Were it not for the grant, we would stop.**
Had it not been for…, would have + part.
**Had it not been for the mistake, we would never have seen it.**
**Had I known, I would have waited.**
blocks.cap: Contraste: Were I… × Had it not been for…

blocks.body: Compare: **Were it not for** = *se não fosse por* (agora); **Had it not been for** = *se não tivesse sido por* (passado).

items.s: Were the lab quiet, I ___ hear the data. (would)
Had it not ___ for a mistake, we would never have seen it. (been)
We would never ___ seen the light. (have)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: And which refers to the past
items.pt: E qual se refere ao passado?

items.ans: Which line is a present hypothesis
items.pt: Qual verso é uma hipótese no presente?

body: **By a stroke of luck.** — Por um golpe de sorte.
**A happy accident.** — Um acidente feliz.
**Light bulb moment.** — Momento de insight.
**Out of left field.** — Totalmente inesperado.
**Strike gold.** — Fazer uma descoberta valiosa.
**The unknown unknown.** — O desconhecido desconhecido.
**Beyond one’s wildest dreams.** — Além dos sonhos mais loucos.
**Chase a hunch.** — Seguir um palpite.
**Which line is a present hypothesis?** — Qual verso é uma hipótese no presente?
**And which refers to the past?** — E qual se refere ao passado?
**“Were I braver, I would ask what we dare not seek.”** — “Were I braver, I would ask what we dare not seek.”

items.label: Ênfase intencional
items.note: A ênfase intencional destaca a palavra que carrega o sentido: sílaba forte, mais longa e mais alta. Mudar a palavra enfatizada muda a mensagem.
words: I didn’t say HE stole it.
I didn’t SAY he stole it.
Not only did she COME, she LED.

prompts.model: Were I you, I would wait.
Were it not for you, I’d be lost.

prompts.q: Use had it not been for.
prompts.model: Had it not been for her, I would have failed.

blocks.task: Write a poem of 4–6 lines with one Were I…, one Were it not for… and one Had it not been for…
blocks.model: Were the night less dark, I would see the stars. Were it not for doubt, we would never ask why. Had it not been for one small spark, we would have missed the fire. Were we to listen, the world would answer. Had I known, I would have stayed.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
